basic.name: Harden Carapace
basic.description: Gain a Shield that grants 40 Spell Armor and absorbs 340~~0.04~~ damage over 3 seconds.

basic.name: Burrow Charge
basic.description:
Burrow to the target location, dealing 91~~0.04~~ damage and briefly stunning enemies in a small area upon surfacing, slowing them by 25% for 2.5 seconds.

Burrow Charge can be reactivated to surface early.

heroic.name: Locust Swarm
heroic.description: Deal 68~~0.04~~ damage per second to nearby enemies. Each enemy damaged restores 24~~0.04~~ Health. Lasts 6 seconds.

heroic.name: Cocoon
heroic.description: Wraps target enemy Hero in a cocoon, rendering them unable to act or be targeted for 7 seconds. Allies of the Hero can attack the cocoon to break it and free them early.

trait.name: Scarab Host
trait.description: Using an Ability spawns a Beetle which loses Health over 10 seconds, attacking nearby enemies for 20~~0.04~~ damage.

activable.name: Scarab Host
activable.description: Press to toggle Legion of Beetles ON.

activable.name: The Traitor King
activable.description:
Gain 10% bonus maximum Health and 20 Spell Armor.

Activate to gain 75 Armor for 4 seconds.

activable.name: Rewind
activable.description: Activate to reset the cooldowns of your Basic Abilities.

level1.name: Nerubian Armor
level1.description: Increase Harden Carapace's Spell Armor by 25.

level1.name: Legion of Beetles
level1.description: Beetles have 30 Spell Armor. Automatically spawn a Beetle every 12 seconds. Can be toggled on and off.

level1.name: Regeneration Master
level1.description:
Quest: Gathering a Regeneration Globe increases your Health Regeneration by 1 per second, up to 30. 

Reward: After gathering 25 Regeneration Globes, you also gain 500 Health.

level4.name: Bed of Barbs
level4.description: Create a bed of spikes along Impale's path that Slows enemies by 25% and deals 21~~0.04~~ damage per second. Spikes persist for 3.5 seconds.

level4.name: Shed Exoskeleton
level4.description: Harden Carapace grants 30% increased Movement Speed for 3 seconds.

level4.name: Underking
level4.description: Increases Burrow Charge range by 20% and damage by 100%.

level7.name: Chitinous Plating
level7.description: While Harden Carapace is active, taking damage from enemy Abilities reduces its cooldown by 1 second, up to 3 seconds.

level7.name: Subterranean Shield
level7.description: Burrow Charge also grants a 400~~0.04~~ point Shield for 5 seconds.

level7.name: Leeching Scarabs
level7.description: Beetles attacks deal 30% more damage and heal Anub'arak 50% of damage dealt if he is nearby.

level10.name: Locust Swarm
level10.description: Deal 68~~0.04~~ damage per second to nearby enemies. Each enemy damaged restores 24~~0.04~~ Health. Lasts 6 seconds.

level10.name: Cocoon
level10.description: Wraps target enemy Hero in a cocoon, rendering them unable to act or be targeted for 7 seconds. Allies of the Hero can attack the cocoon to break it and free them early.

level13.name: Urticating Spines
level13.description: Casting Harden Carapace will also deal 90~~0.04~~ damage to nearby enemies. Deals double damage against Heroes.

level13.name: Burning Beetles
level13.description: Deal 21~~0.04~~ damage per second to nearby enemies. Beetles deal 6~~0.04~~ damage per second to nearby enemies.

level13.name: Acid-Drenched Mandibles
level13.description: Attacking a Hero that is Slowed, Rooted, or Stunned increases Anub'arak's Basic Attack damage by 80% for 4 seconds.

level16.name: Epicenter
level16.description: Increases Burrow Charge impact area by 60% and lowers the cooldown by 1 second for each Hero hit.

level16.name: Debilitation
level16.description: Enemy Heroes hit by Burrow Charge or Impale have their Spell Power reduced by 50% for 4 seconds.

level16.name: Beetle, Juiced
level16.description:
Passive: Beetles gain 30% increased health.

Every 4th Basic Attack spawns a Beetle.

level20.name: Hive Master
level20.description: Gain a permanent Vampire Locust that attacks a nearby enemy every 3 seconds. The Vampire Locust deals 165~~0.04~~ damage and returns to heal Anub'arak for 80~~0.04~~ health.

level20.name: Cryptweave
level20.description: Staying near the Cocoon allows Anub'arak to extend the duration by up to 6 seconds per Cocoon. Upon exiting the Cocoon, enemies take 60~~0.04~~ damage over 4 seconds. This damage is increased by 100% for each second that they were inside.

level20.name: The Traitor King
level20.description:
Gain 10% bonus maximum Health and 20 Spell Armor.

Activate to gain 75 Armor for 4 seconds.

level20.name: Rewind
level20.description: Activate to reset the cooldowns of your Basic Abilities.
